subject: The Burnout Family is growing all the time!
author: ZombieTron
body: Congratulations Xedec! So funny thinking that the kids we used to race with are all grown up with families of their own. We are mostly just enjoying family life with our two little girls, they are lots of fun! Three Fields look like they will be making a Burnout-esque game after Dangerous Golf.... so we are keeping our eyes open for that one... I guess we could all be on our third kids by then!!!
